task.target: The 005CD0E0 quote in the SWE2-EC7-20 update of CONTRACT-phyre-cluster-header.md does not match the shipped image.
task.scope: one quoted instruction sequence in section 'SWE2-EC7-20 update' (~line 698) of CONTRACT-phyre-cluster-header.md
task.question: Which body or image does the 'non-null arm lea r8,[rip+0x26EB505] = 02CB8600 data then jmp 00683080' quote describe? It is not 005CD0E0 in the shipped binary.
task.known_evidence: check_contract_globals.py listed 02CB8600 as a no-writer-no-lea candidate; verifying the quote, the shipped 005CD0E0 (push rbx; sub rsp,0x40; mov r8d,edx; mov rbx,rcx; shr/not/and; xor r9d; xor ecx; call qword[rip+0x2f50a5] -> [rbx]=rax; test rax; jne 0x5cd156; call qword[rip+0x2f4f97]; ... ret at 005CD15D) contains NO lea at all and no jmp to 00683080. An image-wide scan of every 48/4C 8D modrm-05..3D encoding finds ZERO lea instructions targeting 02CB8600, and the literal bytes 00 86 CB 02 do not appear in the image. The quoted structure (lea r8 + jmp 00683080 tail) does not exist anywhere reachable from that text.
task.missing_information: Whether the quote was taken from a different body, a different build, or misattributed -- and what 005CD0E0's non-null arm actually does (it is a CreateEventA-family CRT adapter calling IAT thunks, first arg in rcx not [r8]).
task.why_it_matters: The update is published contract text (b258427b9); a reader reconstructing the loader's event-handle adapter from it would build a body that does not exist. The contract's own quote is also the only thing keeping 02CB8600 from being a clean no-writer-no-lea finding.
task.what_is_blocked: correcting or sourcing the quote; the neighbouring claims about 005CD0A0/005CD120 stand
